entries.zh: 料银（冶银时掺和别料）；掺混银两、兑银
entries.en: to mix (alloy or adulterate) silver; to work silver

entries.zh: 落铜（往银里掺铜、掺假）；混入任何金属
entries.en: to put in copper (adulterate with copper); to mix in any metal

entries.zh: 米糊；把油与米糊（酵面浆）掺和
entries.en: rice paste; to mix oil with leavened rice paste
entries.notes: 第二字有[疑:糊/粓]，且西语 levadura（酵头）与汉字米糊对应稍隔，取拌油米糊义。

entries.zh: 混酒、兑酒（把酒与他物掺和）
entries.en: to mix wine (with water or another liquid); to stir or adulterate wine
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:橙/橋]与对音 kiàu 不合，疑原字为搅；西语 agüer 未能确解，语义据 mezclar el vino 定。

entries.zh: 搭篮（把东西搭作一处，任意掺和）
entries.en: to mix anything with another; to throw things together (lit. put in a basket)
a mixture of sand and earth; sand-and-soil

stingy, base, mean (character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:驃/驁]与吝啌义无直接字形关联，仅据西语 mezquino, apocado 与单音节对音定吝啬义。

entries.en: cunning, crafty; mean-spirited, stingy
treacherous and cunning; deceitful, crafty

entries.zh: 省、省俭（节俭近乎悭吝）；过省（太抠）
entries.en: to economize, be frugal; excessively stingy, miserly
crafty, sly; very stingy
miserly, stingy; niggardly
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:悭/悋]，但两候选字皆指吝啬，语义稳，仅字形待校。

entries.en: stingy, niggardly; miserly

entries.zh: 庸俗、粗俗；廉价（俗价）；悭吝
entries.en: vulgar, common; cheap, inexpensive; stingy
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:俗/倍]，五音节词组未能全解，取俗之廉价/庸俗常义并附悭吝。

entries.zh: 鄙吝卑贱〔原件污损难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: base, vulgar, mean (badly smudged, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 六音节中五音节 T99 污损难辨，第二字[疑:各/吝]，仅据西语与鄙字定大意。

entries.notes: 四音节 T99 污损，M 栏 noqusta edan 非闽南语对音形态，汉字不耳义不可解。

entries.en: obscure compound (literal ink-louse-jerky incomprehensible), gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字组合不成词，仅余对音 bat-sar-poi，西语 apocada 阴性提示状人语，语义无法定夺。
